parameters.query:
SELECT c.bot_id, c.bot_token, c.bot_username
  FROM user_access ua
  JOIN clients c ON c.bot_id = ua.bot_id
 WHERE ua.user_id = $1
   AND (ua.access_until IS NULL OR ua.access_until >= current_date)
 ORDER BY ua.updated_at DESC
 LIMIT 1;
